name: TCS

rounds.description: Core CS subjects (DBMS, Java/Python, OOPs, SQL).

pattern.eligibility: 60% throughout 10th, 12th, and B.Tech / CS Graduation with max 1 active backlog.

technicalQuestions.question: What is the difference between primary key and unique key in SQL?
technicalQuestions.answer: Primary key does not allow NULL values and only 1 allowed per table. Unique key allows one NULL value and multiple unique keys can exist.

technicalQuestions.question: Explain Method Overloading vs Method Overriding.
technicalQuestions.answer: Overloading is compile-time polymorphism in same class with different parameters. Overriding is runtime polymorphism in child class with same method signature.

hrQuestions.question: Why do you want to join TCS?
hrQuestions.answer: Mention TCS market stability, extensive learning platforms (iON), and global project exposure for freshers.
hrQuestions.tips: Highlight your enthusiasm for continuous learning.

codingQuestions.title: Count Vowels and Consonants
codingQuestions.problemStatement: Write a program to count vowels, consonants, and spaces in a string.
codingQuestions.solution: Iterate character by character using char.toLowerCase() and check against vowels set.

experiences.story: NQT test was medium. Technical round focused heavily on SQL joins and my final year React project!

preparationTips: Focus on TCS NQT previous year quantitative aptitude questions.
Be clear on your final year project architecture.

name: Infosys

rounds.description: Mathematical, Reasoning, Verbal, Pseudocode & Puzzle solving.

pattern.eligibility: 60% or 6.0 CGPA in CS / IT degrees.

technicalQuestions.question: What is a Pointers in C++ and how to avoid memory leaks?
technicalQuestions.answer: Pointers store memory addresses. Use delete / free or smart pointers (unique_ptr, shared_ptr) to release heap memory.

hrQuestions.question: Are you comfortable relocating to Infosys Mysore Training Campus?
hrQuestions.answer: Express high enthusiasm for Mysore Global Education Center training.

codingQuestions.title: Reverse a Linked List
codingQuestions.problemStatement: Given head of a singly linked list, reverse the list and return new head.
codingQuestions.solution: Use three pointers: prev, current, next.

experiences.story: Pseudocode questions were tricky. Brush up on loop execution counts and bitwise operators!

preparationTips: Understand core Data Structures like Stacks and Arrays.

technicalQuestions.question: Explain the difference between GET and POST HTTP methods.
technicalQuestions.answer: GET requests parameters in URL, idempotent, cached. POST sends payload in request body, secure, non-cached.

hrQuestions.question: Describe a situation where you worked in a team under tight deadlines.
hrQuestions.answer: Focus on communication, task division, and resolving conflicts.

codingQuestions.title: Find Second Largest Element
codingQuestions.problemStatement: Find the second largest number in an unsorted array without sorting.
codingQuestions.solution: Maintain largest and secondLargest variables in a single pass O(N).

experiences.story: Communication round tests clarity and pronunciation. Speak loudly and steadily in a quiet room!

preparationTips: Ensure good mic quality for the automated communication round.
Practice basic MS Office & Networking questions.

technicalQuestions.question: What is normalized database form (1NF, 2NF, 3NF)?
technicalQuestions.answer: 1NF eliminates repeating groups. 2NF removes partial dependencies. 3NF removes transitive dependencies.

hrQuestions.question: Where do you see yourself in 3 years?
hrQuestions.answer: Aim to be a skilled full-stack developer taking ownership of key modules.

codingQuestions.title: Palindrome String Check
codingQuestions.problemStatement: Check whether a given string is palindrome ignoring case.
codingQuestions.solution: Two-pointer approach comparing start and end characters.

experiences.story: Essay writing test checks grammar and spelling. Keep paragraphs clear!

preparationTips: Practice essay writing online without spellcheck.

technicalQuestions.question: What is the Virtual DOM in React and how does it work?
technicalQuestions.answer: Virtual DOM is an in-memory lightweight copy of Real DOM. React uses diffing algorithm to update only changed nodes efficiently.

hrQuestions.question: How do you handle constructive feedback from senior team members?
hrQuestions.answer: Listen actively, ask clarifying questions, and use it as an opportunity to improve code quality.

codingQuestions.title: Fibonacci Series Iterative
codingQuestions.problemStatement: Generate first N terms of Fibonacci sequence.
codingQuestions.solution: Iterative loop maintaining last two numbers.

preparationTips: Be comfortable writing live code and SQL queries during screen share.

name: Capgemini

technicalQuestions.question: What is REST API and what are standard response status codes?
technicalQuestions.answer: Representational State Transfer API. 200 OK, 201 Created, 400 Bad Request, 401 Unauthorized, 404 Not Found, 500 Server Error.

hrQuestions.question: What are your key strengths and weaknesses?
